embodied.title: EgoSwarm: Learning Decentralized Robot Swarm Intelligence from Human Swarm Demonstrations
embodied.abstract: Advancing from individual embodied intelligence to swarm embodied intelligence is a key step toward scalable, general-purpose embodied intelligence. Complex tasks often require multiple agents to divide responsibilities, coordinate handovers, and manipulate shared objects collaboratively. However, existing robot learning methods rely primarily on individual demonstrations, which provide limited supervision for modeling dependencies among agent actions, while collecting multi-robot demonstrations at scale remains difficult. Human egocentric demonstrations offer a scalable alternative, yet distributed observations from multiple participants cannot directly supervise decentralized policies. We introduce EgoSwarm, the first robot learning framework for learning decentralized multi-robot collaboration from human swarm demonstrations. EgoSwarm collects more than 50 hours of collaborative experience using a robot-free multi-person egocentric system. We introduce the Swarm Interaction Packet (SIP) and Swarm Interaction Token (SIT) to recover cross-agent interaction relations from distributed observations and transform this experience into local supervision consistent with deployment-time information constraints. We further propose SwarmVLA, which transfers knowledge of swarm behavior to decentralized policies conditioned on local observations, local history, and limited neighbor messages. SwarmVLA achieves a mean success rate of 72.2% across three categories of multi-robot collaborative tasks. Project page:https://xitong-c.github.io/EgoSwarm_Page/.
embodied.comment: 22 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Includes supplementary materials. Project page: https://xitong-c.github.io/EgoSwarm_Page/
embodied.titleZh: EgoSwarm：从人类集群演示中学习去中心化机器人集群智能
embodied.summaryZh: 多机器人协作示教难以规模化采集，且各参与者视角分散，无法直接监督去中心化策略；为此搭建无机器人参与的多第一视角人-人协作采集系统，累计 50 余小时协作经验。提出 Swarm Interaction Packet（SIP）与 Swarm Interaction Token（SIT），从分布式观测中恢复跨智能体交互关系，并转换成与部署期信息约束一致的局部监督。据此训练 SwarmVLA，以局部观测、局部历史与有限邻居消息为条件，将集群行为迁移到去中心化策略。在三类多机器人协作任务上平均成功率达 72.2%，为从人类集群数据学习可扩展的具身集群智能提供了可复用路径。
embodied.reason: 人类集群示教驱动去中心化 VLA，命中 VLA 训练与具身智能体方向

embodied.title: CRAFT: A Robot-Agent Harness with Scope-Aware Adaptation
embodied.abstract: A robot may know how to move an object yet still need to learn where it belongs. When a person rejects a placement, the robot must decide whether the correction applies only to that situation or expresses a broader rule. We study this problem in CRAFT (Contextual Requirement Adaptation with Frozen Tools), a framework for learning local requirements without retraining robot skills. It records physical success separately from whether an action meets the requirement. Our scope ladder uses memory when an action has already been judged in a nearly identical situation. Elsewhere, it combines memory, explicit rules and a learner for requirements beyond those rules, weighting their predictions by how well they predicted earlier feedback. Controlled studies show gains over correction memory alone in utility, which rewards acceptable actions and charges for mistakes and questions. In camera-grounded robot simulations, the ladder asks fewer questions than language-model agents with persistent memory, but some of those agents take fewer wrong actions and succeed more often after requirements change. All execution failures and timeouts remain in the evaluation. These results support combining specific memories with broader rules, while leaving reliable adaptation to changing requirements unresolved. All evidence comes from simulation with generated requirements and simulated feedback.
embodied.titleZh: CRAFT：一个具备作用域感知适应能力的机器人智能体 harness
embodied.summaryZh: 人类纠正机器人的放置位置时，机器人需要判断这条纠正只适用于当前情境，还是一条更普遍的规则。CRAFT 框架在不重训机器人技能的前提下学习这类局部要求：把物理执行成功与「是否满足要求」分开记录，并用「作用域阶梯」在几乎相同的情境下直接调用记忆，否则融合记忆、显式规则与一个补足规则之外要求的学习器，按各来源此前预测反馈的准确度加权。受控实验中，该方法在效用（奖励可接受动作、对错误与提问计费）上优于仅用纠正记忆；相机接地的仿真里，它提问次数少于带持久记忆的语言模型智能体，但后者中部分错误动作更少、要求变化后成功率更高，且全部执行失败与超时都计入评估。结果支持把具体记忆与更宽泛的规则结合，而对变化要求的可靠适应仍未解决；证据全部来自仿真生成的要求与模拟反馈。
embodied.reason: 机器人 harness 与记忆/规则的作用域适应，命中智能体式机器人方向

embodied.title: NF-VLA: A Normalizing-Flow Baseline for Vision-Language-Action Learning
embodied.abstract: Autoregressive normalizing flows (NFs) provide a tractable density for learning and sampling continuous robot actions. We show that a single maximum-likelihood objective can train vision--language--action (VLA) policies competitive with leading methods on manipulation benchmarks. We present NF-VLA, which combines conditional autoregressive normalizing flows with score-based action refinement. Its deep--shallow architecture concentrates visual, language, and proprioceptive prefix conditioning in a high-capacity deep block, while unconditioned shallow blocks provide a shared invertible action transformation. The vision--language backbone and flow are jointly trained by exact maximum likelihood on Gaussian-smoothed action chunks. The same learned density supplies a single score-based correction at inference, refining generated actions to account for training-time smoothing without a separately trained denoiser. Trained on LIBERO from a pretrained vision--language backbone without robot pretraining, NF-VLA achieves 98.35\% success across the four standard suites and 72.6\% on LIBERO-Plus using the same checkpoint without further fine-tuning. Ablations show that deep-only prefix conditioning and score-based refinement both improve closed-loop success. Together, these results establish carefully structured autoregressive flows as a competitive approach to VLA control, with one learned density supporting policy training, action generation, and refinement.
embodied.titleZh: NF-VLA:视觉-语言-动作学习的归一化流基线
embodied.summaryZh: VLA 策略的动作生成长期由回归与扩散模型主导，归一化流作为可精确计算密度的方案缺少系统基线。NF-VLA 用条件自回归归一化流配合基于 score 的动作精修:深层高容量块集中承载视觉、语言与本体感知前缀条件，浅层无条件可逆块提供共享动作变换，视觉-语言主干与流模型以高斯平滑动作块上的精确最大似然联合训练;推理时复用同一学到的密度做一次 score 修正，无需单独训练去噪器。仅用 LIBERO 训练、不做机器人预训练的情况下，四个标准套件平均成功率达 98.35%，同一 checkpoint 在 LIBERO-Plus 上零微调取得 72.6%;消融显示仅深层前缀条件与 score 精修各自都提升闭环成功率。结果表明结构设计得当的自回归流可作为 VLA 控制的竞争性方案，单一密度同时支撑策略训练、动作生成与精修。
embodied.reason: VLA 动作生成新路线，方法清晰结果可信，但为 workshop 基线工作

embodied.title: DexFormer 2.0: Towards a Cross-Embodiment Foundation Policy for Dexterous Grasping
embodied.abstract: Dexterous grasping policies are usually trained for one arm paired with one hand. Every new pairing then needs its own policy, and the number of policies grows with every arm and hand added. We ask whether a single policy can control many arm-hand combinations and transfer to pairings and hands it has never seen. This is hard because robots differ in the number, layout, and dynamics of their joints, so their observations and actions share no common interface. We present DexFormer 2.0, a single reinforcement learning policy for cross-embodiment dexterous grasping. It maps every robot to a canonical joint interface with validity masks, encodes each joint's morphology with attention biased by the kinematic tree, and uses a Transformer-XL memory to infer embodiment-dependent dynamics from recent interaction. Trained on 18 combinations of four arms and six hands, it reaches 89% stable success on seen combinations and 51% on six held-out arm-hand pairs, outperforming GRU and DexFormer 1.0 baselines. Without fine-tuning, it also grasps with four new hand types and, through retargeting, with parallel grippers. Ablations show that memory, the kinematic-tree bias, and broader pairing coverage each matter for transfer. On a physical Flexiv arm, distilled students transfer zero-shot from simulation with two hands, including a held-out pair. Project website: https://davidlxu.github.io/dexformer2-web/.
embodied.titleZh: DexFormer 2.0:面向跨本体灵巧抓取的基础策略
embodied.summaryZh: 灵巧抓取策略通常一对臂手单独训练，策略数量随臂与手的组合线性增长。DexFormer 2.0 用单一强化学习策略控制多种臂手组合:将每个机器人映射到带有效掩码的规范化关节接口，以运动学树偏置注意力编码关节形态，并用 Transformer-XL 记忆从近期交互中推断本体相关动力学。在四臂六手的 18 种组合上训练后，已见组合稳定成功率 89%，六个未见的臂手对达 51%，超过 GRU 与 DexFormer 1.0 基线;无需微调即可迁移到四种新手，经重定向也可用于平行夹爪。在实体 Flexiv 机械臂上，蒸馏学生策略从仿真零样本迁移到两种手(含一个未见的臂手对)，为跨本体的具身基础策略提供了可行路线。
embodied.reason: 跨本体 VLA 式基础策略，方法清晰且有真机迁移，命中具身高分方向

embodied.title: Right Goal, Wrong Body: Re-grounding Frozen VLAs under Actuation Shift
embodied.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are capable of producing desired robotic behaviors in ideal settings. However, they often fail when the robot's actuation changes at deployment. For example, remounting, mechanical wear, or command latency changes can lead to failed tasks and unsafe behaviors. To address the inevitable actuation shift, we propose ReGround, an inference-time method that keeps the VLA frozen and re-grounds its intended motion. ReGround learns the deployed robot's dynamics from task-agnostic motor babbling, and then tracks the policy's intended motion while staying close to the policy's own plan. ReGround activates only upon detecting a shift, and needs no rewards, demonstrations, or retraining. We show via two VLAs, eight LIBERO tasks, and five shift settings that ReGround can restore near-oracle success, such as raising $π_{0.5}$'s success from 0.16 to 0.90 under 400 ms latency, while remaining safer than a linear-calibration baseline. Project website and open-source code: https://umersiddique94.github.io/ReGround/.
embodied.comment: Accepted at the SPAIS Workshop at CoRL 2026
embodied.titleZh: 目标正确，本体不匹配：在驱动偏移下重新锚定冻结的VLA
embodied.summaryZh: 部署时的驱动变化（重装、磨损、指令延迟）会让VLA产生错误动作甚至不安全行为。ReGround在推理阶段保持VLA冻结，先用与任务无关的电机自发探索学习部署本体的动力学，再在跟踪策略意图运动的同时约束其贴近原计划，仅在检测到偏移时启用，无需奖励、示范或再训练。在两个VLA、八个LIBERO任务、五种偏移设置下，ReGround可将成功率恢复至接近oracle水平，例如在400ms延迟下把π_{0.5}的成功率从0.16提升到0.90，且比线性校准基线更安全。
embodied.reason: VLA部署期在线自适应，属高分方向且结果扎实，但为workshop短文
